french_tuple: [verse number, 1-based token ordinal, 0-based Unicode code-point start, exclusive end] in verse reading text without notes/markup, trimmed. Apostrophes and internal hyphens retained.

relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 35 verses read and aligned against both pinned projections, then reread and corrected.
notes: Gen 26:1–5: causal, comparative and oath idioms retain the individual Hebrew occurrences; supplied French grammatical material is distinguished from lexical correspondence.
Gen 26:7–11: the negative expressions, fear clause and emphatic death formula are treated in context.
Gen 26:13–22: repeated growth, the well disputes and place-name etymologies retain their contextual phrase links.
Gen 26:28–33: the conditional oath formula and supplied French verbs and subjects in the nominal naming clause are recorded as contextual attachments.
Gen 26:34–35: age, marriage and bitterness-of-spirit constructions are kept in context.
editorial_review.limitations: Both editorial passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
